description: Source code for the TCN75A temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for sampling, configuration, and initialization.

methods.name: tcn75a_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a temperature sample from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: tcn75a_channel_get
methods.description: Converts the raw sample data into a sensor value.

methods.name: tcn75a_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, sets resolution, and configures trigger if applicable.
